app.name: Paper Airplane Chase GX
app.long_description: Native port of the DSiWare release, Paper Airplane Chase. Playable with Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube Controller. Put your supported USA .nds ROM beside boot.dol. Data is prepared automatically on first launch. Endless, Time Attack courses and local two-player Race included. Race uses whichever controller clicked on "Race" as Player 1 and whichever controller responds next as Player 2.
